description: This script automates the creation of a styled Disk Image (DMG) file on macOS. It sets up environment variables, validates inputs, copies application bundles, configures background images and icon placements via AppleScript, mounts the image, applies styling, resizes, and converts it into a compressed DMG file. It is intended for packaging macOS applications with custom visual presentation.

methods.name: to_applescript_list4
methods.description: Converts a space-separated string into a comma-separated list of four elements for AppleScript.

methods.name: to_applescript_pair
methods.description: Converts a space-separated pair into a comma-separated pair for AppleScript.
